stage: P4-B development follow-up to the frozen readout intervention
s07_legacy_check: The existing 75-step, seed-2026 benchmark is separate. Its selected candidate is fixed before the new development outcomes.
mechanism: First retrain with the Fourier channel correction head identically zero throughout training. Then change this residual-free model's time interpolation. For each tap use the principal two-pilot phase difference, align and equally average the two noisy observations in the rotating frame, and apply positive-part shrinkage. The noise-power proxy is the average across taps of squared differences between the two observed tap magnitudes. Training sees no held-out delay profiles. This candidate is specific to the two-row zero-offset comb-2 pilot geometry. One fixed frequency per delay bin over the slot is a simulator-informed prior.

evaluation.seed_formula: seed_base + 10 * condition_index + batch_index; the same slots for every model and training seed

endpoints: Primary descriptive comparison is pooled long12/sparse12/exp16 18 dB coded BLER under paired received slots. Distinguish the learned candidate from both Fourier controls and from its own phase-aware pilot-only control. Report decoded information BER/BLER, denominators by condition and training seed, S07-like 20 dB absolute BER gap, and original S07 gate as a separate diagnostic. No model selection or post-hoc adjustment based on the gate.
limits: Three training replicates share one development evaluation panel. Within-slot codewords share fading. No confirmatory p-values. Principal-phase aliasing is possible beyond half a turn between pilots. Tap-magnitude disagreement is a measurement proxy, not known receiver noise or a calibrated PA variance.
